name: Midnight
overview: Scripture presents midnight as a significant and often solemn time marked by divine intervention and spiritual vigilance. At midnight, God executed judgment in Egypt by striking down the firstborn (Exodus 12:29), and similarly, King Belshazzar met his end during the night (Daniel 5:30). Yet midnight is also a moment for faithful devotion, as the psalmist rises to give thanks for God's righteous judgments (Psalms 119:62). This time of darkness contrasts with the hope of morning joy following weeping, highlighting God's sovereignty over both judgment and restoration (Psalms 30:5).
